title: BUGFIX — Fix FFmpeg force_style comma escaping in clip-maker caption-composer
rationale: workspace/tools/clip-maker/src/caption-composer.ts line 195 has the same FFmpeg 8.1 force_style comma escaping bug fixed in sprint-1406 for agents/scs001-caption/index.ts. srtStyle = array.join(',') creates a comma-separated string; force_style='${srtStyle}' breaks FFmpeg 8.1 filter parsing because single-quote quoting does not protect commas inside filter option values. Fix: escape commas with \, in the srtStyle join separator.

tasks.description: Fix workspace/tools/clip-maker/src/caption-composer.ts line 187-196: change srtStyle array join from ',' to '\\,' (backslash-escaped comma). Remove single-quote wrapping around force_style value. This is the same fix as sprint-1406 applied consistently to the clip-maker pipeline.
